Pour changer : lutin langue fr|en|auto (: To change it: lutin langue fr|en|auto (auto: follow the system language)
Lutin : un assistant IA local qui choisi:
Lutin: a local AI assistant that picks the models that fit your machine.

  lutin               starts (the first time: guided installation; otherwise it changes nothing)
  lutin setup         guided installation (no effect if Lutin is already installed; --reconfigurer to change)
  lutin update        updates Lutin and looks for model updates
  lutin chat          chat in the terminal
  lutin modeles       recommended models for your machine, installed ones, updates
  lutin pin           PIN code to connect a device (« network » level)
  lutin appareils     connected devices / revoke
  lutin securite      current access level
  lutin hors-ligne    strict offline mode (no connection to the Internet)
  lutin travaux       workspace folders (list, add, remove, active)
  lutin importer      take over a Claude project (CLAUDE.md, .claude/): work in it or in a copy
  lutin reprendre     take over the data of another assistant (conversations, memory, skills, settings)
  lutin journal       what Lutin modified or ran, with which approval
  lutin bench         measure a model on this machine (speed, tools, code, French)
  lutin sauvegarde    export your data to a .zip; lutin restaurer to put it back
  lutin doctor        diagnostics (to attach to a problem report)
Commandes :\n /aide cet:
Commands:
  /aide                 this help
  /nouvelle             new conversation
  /liste                your recent conversations
  /reprendre <number>   resume a conversation from the list
  /modele [name]        show or change the model
  /mode travail|ecriture
  /reflexion            turn reasoning on / off
  /quitter              leave (Ctrl+D too)
While an answer is running: Ctrl+C stops it (what is already done is kept).
Attention : toute personne qui connaît l: Warning: anyone who knows the PIN code and is on your network will be able to ask Lutin to read the files of the workspace. Automatic approvals are turned off in this mode.
Attention : exposer un assistant capable: Warning: exposing an assistant able to read files and run commands to the Internet is risky. Only do it behind strong authentication (ideally with a second factor) and a valid HTTPS. Automatic approvals are turned off in this mode.
Personne d'autre ne peut y accéder. Reco: Nobody else can access it. Recommended.
Téléphone, tablette, autre PC de la mais: Phone, tablet, another PC at home, with a PIN code for each new device.
Depuis Internet, derrière un proxy: From the Internet, behind a proxy
Lutin n'est pas exposé directement : un: Lutin is not exposed directly: a proxy (Authelia, Authentik…) takes care of identity.
